law: Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, Sections 2, 3, 9, 10, 11 and 13
rule_plain: A girl must be at least 18 and a boy at least 21 to marry. A man over 18 who marries a child can get up to two years in strict jail or a fine up to Rs 1 lakh. People who perform, help or allow a child marriage, including parents, can also be punished.
what_you_can_do: Call Child Helpline 1098. It is free and works 24 hours a day.
Tell the District Social Welfare Officer. In Tamil Nadu this officer is the Child Marriage Prohibition Officer.
A court can issue an order to stop a child marriage before it happens.
A person married as a child can ask the district court to cancel the marriage, any time before they turn 20 (two years after becoming an adult).
where_to_get_help: Child Helpline 1098, District Social Welfare Officer (Child Marriage Prohibition Officer), or the police.
